capability_usage: Reference shared operational capabilities by default; instantiate a workspace-specialized capability only when explicitly selected.
claim_ceiling: A proposed runtime/capability usage policy and pure selection fixture only; no central host deployment, runtime duplication, native authorization or multi-tenant security qualification.
native_permission_policy: Actual operations must pass the selected host native gate for their workspace/action. Configuration or this pure resolver grants no permission.
state_policy: Workspace records and authority stay explicitly scoped. A common backend can store multiple scopes; separate databases, stores or runtime copies are not required by workspace creation.

workspace_selection_contract.runtime_ref: null means deployment target pending; fixture resolver may use an explicitly supplied central catalog default.
workspace_selection_contract.scope_binding: workspace/project/scope/revision must match the selected target context.
workspace_selection_contract.specialization_ref: required only for specialized behavior; scope and compatibility must match.
